# gws recipe: Find large Drive files

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the find-large-files recipe: identify large Google Drive files consuming storage quota — list files sorted by `quotaBytesUsed desc` in a table with id, name, size, mimeType and owners, then review and decide what to archive or move. Distinct from the lot 31 Drive recipes (`backup-sheet-as-csv`, `organize-drive-folder`, `bulk-download-folder` — none cover storage quota): this one is the quota audit. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); the `gws-drive` prerequisite comes from the same repo but is not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
